verdict.rationale: Avalara's Managed Returns API is documented to let partners embed 'tax return preparation and filing' into workflows (avalara-docs-31), but there is no vendor evidence of a filing-guarantee/penalty-coverage commitment, and a first-hand community account explicitly states that even with Avalara, per-jurisdiction tax registration and filing still has to be handled separately (avalara-comm-1) — directly contradicting the 'fully automatic, on time, in every jurisdiction' claim. missing for 10: explicit on-time guarantee/penalty indemnification language, evidence of automatic filing across ALL registered jurisdictions without manual intervention, and corroboration that the guarantee is honored in practice.
